**Role: Java Full stack Developer (NoSQl and Solr exp)**
**Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite \- 5 days a week)**
 We’re looking for a Java Full Stack Developer who brings strong backend engineering depth along with modern front\-end development experience to build scalable, enterprise\-grade digital solutions. In this role, you will develop and maintain applications using Java 8, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Angular, Kafka, and distributed data technologies such as Cassandra or MongoDB, while helping design performant integrations, search capabilities, and data processing workflows across complex ecosystems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using Java 8, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs
* Design, build, and support full stack solutions with strong backend services and responsive front\-end interfaces using Angular 8 or above
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver intuitive, user\-centered application experiences
* Build and integrate scalable messaging and event\-driven solutions using Kafka, JMS, and related integration frameworks
* Work with NoSQL databases such as Cassandra or MongoDB to model, store, and retrieve large\-scale data efficiently
* Design and optimize queries for Oracle, SQL, and NoSQL data stores based on application and performance requirements
* Implement and support enterprise search solutions using Solr and/or OpenSearch
* Contribute to large\-scale data engineering and processing use cases leveraging Apache Spark
* Create reusable, secure, and high\-performing APIs and services for internal and external system integrations
* Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues across distributed systems and environments
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives to elevate engineering quality
* Support best practices in software development, including clean code, testing, documentation, and version control
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience as a Java Full Stack Developer in enterprise application environments
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java 8, Spring Boot, and REST API development
* Experience building front\-end applications using Angular 8 or above
* Solid experience with messaging and integration technologies such as Kafka, JMS, and related event\-driven patterns
* Hands\-on experience with Cassandra or MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
* Experience working with Solr and/or OpenSearch for indexing, search, and retrieval use cases
* Working knowledge of Apache Spark for distributed data processing and analytics workflows
* Experience designing and optimizing queries for Oracle, SQL, and NoSQL databases
* Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns
* Familiarity with application performance tuning, debugging, and troubleshooting in production\-grade systems
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams
* Experience with Agile delivery methods and modern software development lifecycle practices preferred
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and automated testing practices is a plus


 The base salary for this position is $92,250 to $101,500 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance.
